title: The pet’s documents with you
description: A set of certificates and discharge notes you can open and hand over regardless of the clinic.

blocks.text: A treatment history can end up spread across several institutions. Before a trip the owner hunts for one certificate among old emails and photographs.

quote.text: The MOST useful thing an app could do would be to allow access to my guys vaccination record. It's needed often.

blocks.text: Save files by animal, date and purpose. For a trip or a new doctor, put together a separate package and check it before sending.
The recipient needs a selected copy of the documents; access to the whole family profile is not required for that.
